summary: Bio Essence Corp filed an 8-K/A to amend a prior 8-K, reporting its acquisition of MediFlow AI software (formerly AcuVital) from Zhituo Software. Consideration is $3.5 million in common stock, subject to board valuation approval. Zhituo's principals assigned shares to themselves; closings were deemed effective May 19, 2026. No advisors or premiums cited. The deal lacks disclosed trading data or regulatory clocks. Watch for shareholder dilution and the board's final share count determination as risk-arb angles.
